t: Tracing back where any of it came from
a: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
p: Wa mā bikum min niʿmatin fa-mina-llāh, thumma idhā massakumu-ḍ-ḍurru fa-ilayhi taj'arūn.
m: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
